title: 设计数字容器系统
summary: 系统支持把指定下标的数字改为给定值，并查询当前包含某数字的最小下标；不存在返回负一。
insight: 用 indexToNumber 记录每个下标当前值，同时为每个数字维护有序下标集合。修改时从旧值集合删除，再加入新值集合；查询取集合首项。
pitfalls: 同一下标可被反复修改
旧值集合必须同步删除下标

solutions.title: 双向映射与有序下标集
solutions.idea: 同时维护下标当前值和数字对应的有序下标。
steps: indexToNumber 与 numberToIndices 初始化为空
change：若有 old，从 old 的 TreeSet 删除 index；更新映射并加入新集合

complexity.time: O(log n) 修改，O(log n) 查询或取首项

code.java: class NumberContainers { Map<Integer,Integer> indexToNumber=new HashMap<>();Map<Integer,TreeSet<Integer>> numberToIndices=new HashMap<>();public NumberContainers(){}public void change(int index,int number){Integer old=indexToNumber.get(index);if(old!=null)numberToIndices.get(old).remove(index);indexToNumber.put(index,number);numberToIndices.computeIfAbsent(number,key->new TreeSet<>()).add(index);}public int find(int number){TreeSet<Integer> indices=numberToIndices.get(number);return indices==null||indices.isEmpty()?-1:indices.first();} }
code.kotlin: class NumberContainers { private val indexToNumber=HashMap<Int,Int>();private val numberToIndices=HashMap<Int,java.util.TreeSet<Int>>();fun change(index:Int,number:Int){indexToNumber[index]?.let{numberToIndices[it]!!.remove(index)};indexToNumber[index]=number;numberToIndices.getOrPut(number){java.util.TreeSet()}.add(index)}fun find(number:Int):Int{return numberToIndices[number]?.firstOrNull()?:-1} }
code.cpp: class NumberContainers { unordered_map<int,int> indexToNumber;unordered_map<int,set<int>> numberToIndices;public:NumberContainers(){}void change(int index,int number){if(indexToNumber.count(index))numberToIndices[indexToNumber[index]].erase(index);indexToNumber[index]=number;numberToIndices[number].insert(index);}int find(int number){return numberToIndices[number].empty()?-1:*numberToIndices[number].begin();} };
